contracts: 00476d50 uses original from DPID, requested recipient, payload pointer and DWORD length; any nonzero reliable selects flags1, otherwise flags0. NULL peer makes no call.
Official local DirectX7 SDK supplies DirectPlay3A declarations; Send vtable offset0x68 and guaranteed flag1 checked at compile time. Existing pinned VC5 headers/flags unaffected in every existing TU.
00423710 sets byte payload length, zero-pads to DWORD for XOR, updates scratch cursor, and passes original unpadded length to source transport. Real source framing helpers reused.
dependencies: Real native DirectPlay3A interface, official SDK declarations; COM factory/ownership imports from pinned ole32.lib
Existing real source packet framing/receive checksum and VC5 CRT
native_factory_note: DirectPlayCreate(NULL) was observed returning E_INVALIDARG in the initial diagnostic. Final compiled tests use CoInitialize/CoCreateInstance(CLSID_DirectPlay, IID_IDirectPlay3A) without a provider/session; the initial factory failure is not counted as passing validation.
limits: Actual native DirectPlay3A unopened-interface failures tested, not successful delivery, session ownership, peer exchange or network gameplay. No InitializeConnection/Open/CreatePlayer calls in checks.
Source context init/dispose owns AddRef/Release; explicit DPID/interface/writer replaces original globals. Native HRESULT and call counters are source diagnostic extensions.
Framing source guards apply to valid <=255-byte payload packets; invalid/repeated finish rejects before any native call.
Full physics owner and mode-specific packet construction/dispatch remain WIP; native send restoration is not full networking admission.
Functional source, no raw byte-match or original code execution claim.
